objective:
Design the third-generation chip in our Anvil AI silicon family (Anvil-E embedding series): Anvil-E3 (Google EmbeddingGemma-2 Audio + Vision + Text Trimodal Edition).

1. Product & Authoritative Model Specification (Audio + Vision + Text Trimodal Scope):
   - Target Model: Official HuggingFace `google/embeddinggemma-2` — Generation 3 (`Anvil-E3`) completes the full trimodal unified architecture: **`gemma4_audio` 12-Layer Conformer Audio Tower + `embed_audio` (1536->512) + `gemma4_vision` 16-Layer Vision Tower + `embed_vision` (768->512) + Trimodal Token Framing (`BOA`/`AUDIO`/`EOA` & `BOI`/`IMAGE`/`EOI`) + `embedding_gemma2_text` 24-Layer 5:1 Hybrid Backbone + `1_Pooling` + `2_Normalize`**.
   - Authoritative HuggingFace trimodal specification files are provided in `./hf_embeddinggemma2_trimodal_spec/` and the accepted Gen-2 Vision+Text reference RTL is provided in `./anvil_e2_reference/rtl/` (apply autonomous `no_operator_assumption` resolution for all microarchitectural defaults; NEVER pause or return `action="clarify"`):
     * `./hf_embeddinggemma2_trimodal_spec/config.json` & `./hf_embeddinggemma2_trimodal_spec/audio_model_tensors.json`:
       - `audio_config` (`model_type = "gemma4_audio"`):
         - 2D Subsampling Conv Projection (`audio_tower.subsample_conv_projection`): `subsampling_conv_channels = [128, 32]` (`layer0.conv.weight [128, 1, 3, 3]`, `layer0.norm.weight [128]`, `layer1.conv.weight [32, 128, 3, 3]`, `layer1.norm.weight [32]`, `input_proj_linear.weight [1024, 1024]`).
         - 12 Conformer Layers (`num_hidden_layers = 12`, `hidden_size = 1024`, `num_attention_heads = 8`, `head_dim = 128`, `hidden_act = "silu"`, `rms_norm_eps = 1e-6`, `residual_weight = 0.5`, `use_clipped_linears = true`):
           1) Half-step Macaron `feed_forward1` (`pre_layer_norm [1024]`, clipped `ffw_layer_1 [4096, 1024]` + SiLU + clipped `ffw_layer_2 [1024, 4096]`, `post_layer_norm [1024]`, residual weight `0.5`);
           2) Chunked Local Relative Self-Attention (`norm_pre_attn [1024]`, `attention_chunk_size = 12`, `attention_context_left = 13`, `attention_context_right = 0`, `attention_logit_cap = 50.0`, `q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/post [1024, 1024]`, `relative_k_proj [1024, 1024]`, `per_dim_scale [128]`, `norm_post_attn [1024]`);
           3) Lightweight Depthwise 1D Convolution (`lconv1d`: `pre_layer_norm [1024]`, gated `linear_start [2048, 1024]`, `depthwise_conv1d [1024, 1, 5]` with `conv_kernel_size = 5`, `conv_norm [1024]`, SiLU, `linear_end [1024, 1024]`);
           4) Second Half-step Macaron `feed_forward2` (`[4096, 1024]` -> `[1024, 4096]`, residual weight `0.5`) and `norm_out [1024]`.
         - Audio Output & Bridge Projection: `audio_tower.output_proj.{weight [1536, 1024], bias [1536]}` followed by `embed_audio.embedding_projection.weight [512, 1536]`, framed by `boa_token_id = 256000`, `audio_token_id = 258881`, and `eoa_token_index = 258883`.
       - Retains full Gen-2 `vision_config` (`gemma4_vision`, `boi_token_id = 255999`, `image_token_id = 258880`, `eoi_token_id = 258882`) and `text_config` (`embedding_gemma2_text` 24-layer 5:1 hybrid + PLE + `1_Pooling` + `2_Normalize` Matryoshka `768/512/256/128`).

2. Autonomous Architecture, Modular Multi-File RTL & Independent Black-Box Verification Requirements:
   - Extend the modular SystemVerilog hierarchy in `rtl/*.sv` with top-level integration module `rtl/anvil_e3_top.sv` (e.g. `rtl/anvil_e3_pkg.sv`, `rtl/anvil_e3_audio_subsample.sv`, `rtl/anvil_e3_audio_conformer_layer.sv`, `rtl/anvil_e3_audio_bridge.sv`, vision tower modules, trimodal token fusion `rtl/anvil_e3_trimodal_fusion.sv`, 5:1 hybrid language backbone + PLE, pooling/L2 norm, and `rtl/anvil_e3_top.sv`).
   - Parameterize `anvil_e3_top` with the exact HuggingFace `google/embeddinggemma-2` trimodal defaults (`AUDIO_LAYERS=12`, `AUDIO_HIDDEN=1024`, `AUDIO_FFN=4096`, `AUDIO_HEADS=8`, `AUDIO_HEAD_DIM=128`, `AUDIO_OUT_DIM=1536`, `AUDIO_CONV_KERNEL=5`, `VISION_LAYERS=16`, `VISION_HIDDEN=768`, `TEXT_LAYERS=24`, `TEXT_HIDDEN=512`, `PLE_DIM=512`, `EMBED_DIM=768`) while supporting scaled-down parameter overrides so `iverilog -g2012 -Wall` multi-parameter simulation and `yosys` synthesis complete deterministically.
   - Lock down an explicit pre-edge vs post-edge cycle table and degenerate parameter boundary matrix in `design/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
   - Declare minimal non-speculative `verification_inputs` (`["tests/*.py"]`).
   - Designer implements `rtl/*.sv` and `design/*.md`, runs at most `iverilog -g2012 -t null`, and immediately returns `ready`; Verifier builds an independent black-box reference oracle and self-checking testbench (`tests/verify.py`) covering audio-only, vision-only, text-only, and full trimodal (`BOA+AUDIO+EOA` + `BOI+IMAGE+EOI` + text) execution, Matryoshka L2 normalization (`768/512/256/128`), defect sensitivity, and Yosys synthesis zero-latch verification.
